name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Dwarf goes with Wolf or Fenwick goes with Wolf.
Between Cat and Wolf, one goes with Human and the other with Tiefling.
If Tiefling goes with Cat, then Fenwick goes with Raven.
Either Kael goes with Dwarf, or Human goes with Wolf — but not both.

hints.text: Suppose Dwarf went with Wolf — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Dwarf goes with Wolf.
Wolf goes with Dwarf, so Human can't go with Wolf.
Wolf goes with Dwarf, so Tiefling can't go with Wolf.
…but now the clue “Between Cat and Wolf, one goes with Human and the other with Tiefling” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Dwarf does not go with Wolf.
